<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Special session agenda:</strong> The Union Cabinet is set to discuss the Delimitation Bill and women&#x27;s reservation ahead of a special Parliament session beginning November 30, which has drawn sharp criticism from the Congress and other opposition parties.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPNUNHNFdDT0U0a29GR3p4SWpicE13ME9KeTlBekNpcjBqSWlVY2R2UnZHYWZBWnc1Z1N3Y042UzNEaVZBRlNTZHdUdm5Ya0Jza0dKUUdyOXVkY1pfa2ZLczNtNmlhczd5MG1BQkdQcUxVY215Z3ZMUW5rV2xxTXBnVUJrWTdRc21GT21BXzZ0b3VTQnYycUZPUDNjTW5YaWljTDQ5MEJyRXU3cU0yeUFBRDc0TEUwV3YwNmtNTzNn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition and regional resistance:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav and MK Stalin, have vowed to resist the Delimitation Bill, with Stalin explicitly stating he will not compromise on Tamil Nadu’s current Lok Sabha seat share.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOd0FjdXRnQ0dEZUo5dGZlbHhyQ0Faa2hxZ0hvdHJjU194U195aHJjbnF4NVFKNERWVUlGUi1TQlJIN3BQZTdkd2ctUEZlTjJjejJyYlkyeWxZdmg5WFptbFRTX1ZVSnByVmFGX1dSV2lnRWRIOTFCWDl3eEVLOHpGZEQwc3kyM1RNLXpjTmtPQjlJYWt2dnhXS2dULTdXWElXSzk1Vm9hTmRtc2VVTEJ5YW15SDUwbzFGcFFKLQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary strategy:</strong> As the NDA assesses its numbers to potentially pass the bill, major parties including the Congress and NCP have issued whips to their MPs to ensure attendance during the high-stakes session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
</ul>
